summary: INNEOVA Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, announcing its unaudited consolidated balance sheet as of March 31, 2026. The filing provides financial statements, including assets of $50.3M, liabilities of $44.9M, and shareholders' equity of $5.4M. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation filing.
